prompt: Estimate the yearly global market for replacement passenger seats in commercial airliners, in dollars.

steps.label: Pick the drivers that build the estimate

model_answer: 27.5k (commercial passenger aircraft in service worldwide) × 175 (seats per aircraft) × 0.11 (share of seats replaced each year) × 5.5k (average price per replacement seat) ≈ $2.91B
explanation: 27.5k (commercial passenger aircraft in service worldwide) × 175 (seats per aircraft) × 0.11 (share of seats replaced each year) × 5.5k (average price per replacement seat) ≈ $2.91B.
